what: Hand-drawn people and animal pieces stay in place for the first half of a 1.5s beat, and in the second half step aside 10px down (or 10px down-left or down-right, tilted 5°), alternating abruptly with no in-between drawing (steps(1)) — like a two-cut paper puppet show. Giving each piece a different delay (.15 · .25 · .4s) makes the group fidget off-beat

options.--fx-x: Horizontal offset distance (css), default 0px — original lb −10px · rb 10px
options.--fx-y: Vertical gap for stepping aside (css), default 10px
options.--fx-rot: Tilt when stepping aside (css), default 0deg — original value 5deg (with --fx-y: 0px)

from.where: about.html .sg-st hand-drawn kids and trees (original story.css @keyframes lb translate(−10px,10px) · rb (10px,10px) · bt (0,10px) · deg rotate(5deg) placed at 50%, 1.5s steps(1) infinite, delayed .15·.25·.4s)
